en: adv. for all time; for a very long time; (informal) used to say that something seems to take too long
ex: I will remember this day forever.
我會永遠記得這一天。

en: n. a structure that sends water up into the air, usually in a park or garden; a drinking fountain; the place where something begins; a source of something
ex: Children were playing near the fountain in the square.
孩子們在廣場的噴水池旁玩耍。

en: v. to become hard because of cold; to preserve food by making it very cold; to stop moving suddenly because of fear; to keep prices or wages at a fixed level; n. a period of very cold weather; a stop on something such as wages
ex: The lake freezes in winter.
湖水在冬天會結冰。

en: a large cold box or a part of a refrigerator that keeps food frozen
ex: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。

en: a. happening often; common or usual; v. to go to a place often
ex: There are frequent buses between the airport and the city.
機場和市區之間的公車班次很頻繁。

en: n. a sudden strong feeling of fear; a short period of fear; (informal) a person who looks very strange or funny
ex: She screamed in fright when she saw the spider.
她看到蜘蛛時嚇得尖叫。

en: to make someone feel afraid; to become afraid
ex: The loud noise frightened the baby.
巨大的聲音嚇到了嬰兒。

en: n. an amount of money saved or collected for a special purpose; a large amount of something; (funds) money available to spend; v. to provide money for something
ex: The charity raised funds for the new hospital.
慈善團體為新醫院籌募資金。

en: n. the soft thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals; clothing made from the hair of an animal; a hard layer that forms inside a kettle
ex: She wore a warm fur coat in the snow.
她在雪中穿著一件保暖的皮草大衣。

en: a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to about 3.8 liters in the US and 4.5 liters in the UK
ex: The car uses one gallon of gas for every thirty miles.
這輛車每三十英里用一加侖汽油。

en: n. a group of young people who spend time together, sometimes doing illegal things; a group of criminals; a group of workers; v. to join together in a group
ex: The police arrested several members of a street gang.
警方逮捕了幾名街頭幫派成員。

en: n. a space or opening in something; a difference between two things; a period of time when something is missing; a store that sells clothes; v. to make a gap in something
ex: There is a gap in the fence where the dog escaped.
籬笆有個缺口，狗就是從那裡跑掉的。

en: n. a liquid fuel made from petroleum, used in car engines (US); (gas) a short form of gasoline
ex: The car ran out of gasoline on the highway.
那輛車在公路上沒油了。

en: n. a movement of the hand, arm or head that expresses an idea or feeling; something you do to show your feelings or intentions; v. to make a movement to show something
ex: He made a rude gesture at the driver.
他對司機比了一個不禮貌的手勢。

en: n. a quick look; a quick sight of something; v. to look at something quickly; to hit something and go off in another direction; to read quickly
ex: She glanced at her watch and stood up.
她瞄了一眼手錶就站起來。

en: a. relating to the whole world; affecting all parts of a group or situation; considering all parts of something
ex: Global warming is a serious problem for all countries.
全球暖化對所有國家都是嚴重的問題。

en: n. a soft, steady light; a warm feeling in your body or face; a feeling of happiness or pride; v. to produce a soft, steady light; to look healthy or happy
ex: The candle gave off a warm glow.
蠟燭散發出溫暖的光。

en: n. a game in which players use clubs to hit a small hard ball into a series of holes; v. to play golf
ex: My father plays golf every Sunday morning.
我爸爸每週日早上都打高爾夫。

en: n. informal talk about other people's private lives, often not true; a person who likes to talk about other people's private lives; v. to talk about other people's private lives
ex: Don't believe all the gossip you hear at work.
別相信你在公司聽到的所有八卦。

en: n. the person who is the elected head of the government of a US state; a person who is sent by a king or queen to rule a colony; a person who is a member of a group that manages an organization; a device that controls the speed of a machine
ex: The governor announced new rules for the state.
州長宣布了該州的新規定。

en: v. to take or hold something suddenly or roughly; to get something quickly because you are in a hurry; (informal) to impress someone; n. a sudden quick movement to take something; a tool for picking things up
ex: She grabbed her coat and ran out of the door.
她抓起外套衝出門。

en: n. a person who has completed a university degree; (US) a person who has finished high school; v. to complete a degree or course at a school or university; to move up to a higher level; a. relating to study after a first degree
ex: She graduated from the university with a degree in biology.
她從大學畢業，主修生物。

en: v. to take hold of something firmly; to understand something completely; n. a firm hold; the ability to understand something; control or power
ex: He grasped the rope with both hands.
他用雙手抓緊繩子。

en: v. to smile widely, usually showing your teeth; n. a wide smile
ex: He grinned from ear to ear when he heard the good news.
聽到好消息，他笑得合不攏嘴。

en: a person whose job is to cut, wash and arrange people's hair
ex: I made an appointment with my hairdresser for Saturday.
我跟美髮師預約了星期六。

en: n. a narrow passage inside a building with rooms on both sides; the area just inside the front door of a house
ex: She walked down the hallway to her room.
她沿著走廊走向自己的房間。

en: n. a small number of people or things; the amount that you can hold in one hand; (informal) a person or thing that is hard to control or deal with
ex: Only a handful of students passed the difficult exam.
只有少數學生通過這場困難的考試。

en: a small square piece of cloth or paper that you use for wiping your nose or eyes
ex: He took out a handkerchief and wiped his forehead.
他拿出手帕擦額頭。

en: a. useful and easy to use or deal with; near and therefore easy to reach; good at using your hands to make or repair things
ex: It is handy to keep a flashlight in the car.
車裡放支手電筒很方便。

en: n. an area of water next to the land where ships can stay safely; a place of safety; v. to give shelter to someone; to keep a feeling or idea in your mind for a long time
ex: Several fishing boats were anchored in the harbor.
幾艘漁船停泊在港口。

en: a. causing harm; likely to hurt your health or damage something
ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
吸菸對你的健康有害。

en: n. the activity of gathering crops; the crops that are gathered; the result of an action; v. to gather a crop; to collect something for use
ex: Farmers are busy during the rice harvest.
稻米收成時農夫非常忙碌。

en: a. done too quickly without thinking carefully; hurried; (of a person) quick to become angry or act without thinking
ex: Don't make a hasty decision you might regret.
別做出會讓你後悔的草率決定。

en: v. (of a baby bird or animal) to come out of an egg; to make a baby bird come out of an egg; to plan a secret or evil scheme; n. an opening in a ship's deck; a door in an aircraft or spacecraft
ex: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
這些蛋大約三週後會孵化。

en: a. causing strong feelings of hate or dislike; very unpleasant; (old) full of hate
ex: What a hateful thing to say to a friend!
對朋友說這種話真是可惡！

en: n. grass that has been cut and dried to be used as food for animals; (informal) a small amount of money
ex: The farmer stored hay in the barn for the winter.
農夫把乾草存放在穀倉裡過冬。
ph: make hay while the sun shines

en: n. the place from which an organization or an army is controlled; the main offices of a company; the people working at a head office
ex: The company's headquarters is located in Taipei.
這家公司的總部設在台北。

en: n. a large pile of things lying on top of each other; (informal) a large amount; a very old car (informal); v. to put things on top of each other; to put a lot of something on a plate
ex: There was a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
地板上堆著一堆髒衣服。
ph: at the top of the heap

en: n. a machine that makes a room or a vehicle warm; a part of a machine that heats something
ex: Turn on the heater; it's freezing in here.
把暖氣打開，這裡冷死了。

en: n. the back part of your foot; the part of a shoe that supports the heel; a rude or untrustworthy person (informal); v. to put a heel on a shoe; to tilt a ship to one side; (of a dog) to follow closely behind someone
ex: She hurt her heel when she jumped from the wall.
她從牆上跳下來時傷到了腳跟。
